findings.message: The change replaces the caller-provided context with context.Background(), which disables cancellation and deadline propagation. This violates the function signature contract (which accepts a context) and can lead to resource leaks or unresponsive behavior if the caller expects the request to be cancelled.
findings.suggestion: Revert to using the provided ctx parameter: http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, c.Endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
